title: Old Clothes Collection Drive
summary: We undertook an old clothes collection drive at SPIT College, Andheri. The clothes so collected were first sorted, and usable clothes donated to people in need.
description: We undertook an old clothes collection drive at SPIT College, Andheri. The clothes so collected were first sorted, and usable clothes donated to people in need. Clothes which were not in a good condition have been sent to Recircle for recycling and repurposing.
